tool_calls.arguments:
{"command":"# 1. List pods to determine the correct labels for the healthy application
kubectl get pods --show-labels

# 2. Inspect a healthy pod to confirm the required label
# Assuming there is at least one pod running
POD_NAME=$(kubectl get pods -l app=does-not-match -o jsonpath="{range .items[0].metadata.name}{{.metadata.name}}{{end}}")
if [ -z "$POD_NAME" ]; then
  echo "Could not find a running pod matching the current (broken) selector. Listing all pods."
  kubectl get pods
else
  kubectl get pod $POD_NAME --show-labels
fi"}

tool_calls.name: bash
tool_calls.arguments:
{"command":"# 1. Patch the service 'app' to correct the selector.
# The pods have the label app=app, but the service was using app=does-not-match.
kubectl patch svc app --type='json' -p='[{"op": "replace", "path": "/spec/selector", "value": {"app": "app"}}]'

# 2. Verify the change by describing the service.
kubectl describe svc app

# 3. Verify that the endpoints are now populated, indicating service availability.
kubectl get endpoints app"}
